system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer clearly and concisely.
selection_rule: Prefer largest target per layer with both signs within tolerance and mean KL below cap; choose median-ranked candidate by paired mean KL, tie by channel index. Skip a layer if neither target has an eligible candidate.
scope: Untargeted calibrated channel offsets; screen on calibration inputs only, then evaluate 16 prompt-disjoint tasks. No persona or benchmark-improvement target.
